2610.11354.title: AdaptEvo: Adaptive Agent Learning with Evolving Supervision
2610.11354.paper_summary: Rule-governed contextual decision tasks require models to apply specified rules to case-specific context and evidence. Written rules can leave gaps in decision guidance and process evaluation, while reference judgments vary in their support from the rules and evidence. To address these challenges, we introduce AdaptEvo, a framework for learning under imperfect supervision that couples confidence-adaptive policy optimization with evolving decision knowledge and evaluation rubrics. Its Training module uses Confidence-Adaptive GRPO (CA-GRPO) to balance outcome and process rewards according to reference confidence. Its Evolution module synthesizes reusable decision knowledge from recurring failures across training cases and refines process rubrics to detect overlooked errors. To support empirical evaluation, we construct an industrial multimodal content moderation dataset comprising a training set and In-Period and Out-of-Period test sets, with the latter collected under changed rules. Using Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, AdaptEvo achieves 61.9% exact-label accuracy and 72.2% binary decision accuracy on In-Period, exceeding GRPO by 7.5 and 3.7 percentage points, respectively. On Out-of-Period, the policy trained with CA-GRPO retains exact-label accuracy gains over the base model across evaluated checkpoints without injected decision knowledge, while GRPO declines with continued training. CA-GRPO also outperforms the tested fixed reward mixtures on both Out-of-Period metrics.
2610.11354.paper_summary_zh: 規則驅動的情境決策任務要求模型將指定的規則應用於特定案例的情境和證據中。書面規則可能在決策指導和過程評估中留下空白，而參考判斷在其對規則和證據的支持上存在變化。為了解決這些挑戰，我們引入了AdaptEvo，一個在不完美監督下學習的框架，將信心自適應的政策優化與不斷演變的決策知識和評估標準結合起來。其訓練模塊使用信心自適應GRPO (CA-GRPO) 根據參考信心平衡結果和過程獎勵。其演變模塊從訓練案例中的重複失敗中綜合可重用的決策知識，並細化過程標準以檢測被忽視的錯誤。為了支持實證評估，我們構建了一個工業多模態內容審核數據集，包括訓練集和在期內及期外測試集，後者是在變更規則下收集的。使用Qwen3.6-35B-A3B，AdaptEvo在期內達到61.9%的精確標籤準確率和72.2%的二元決策準確率，分別超過GRPO 7.5和3.7個百分點。在期外，使用CA-GRPO訓練的政策在評估的檢查點上保持了相對於基礎模型的精確標籤準確率的增益，而GRPO在持續訓練中下降。CA-GRPO在期外的兩個指標上也超越了測試的固定獎勵混合。
